remaining_tasks.blocker: IMU sampler talks to non-existent MPU6050 at 0x68; real hardware is LSM6DSOX at 0x6A. Dashboard renders fine but live IMU stream is meaningless until Phase 11 sampler rewrite lands.

blockers.description: IMU sampler hardcoded to MPU6050 @ 0x68; Pi 5 v2 build has LSM6DSOX @ 0x6A. Dashboard UI + SSE + tiles verified working, but live G-force/gyro stream is garbage (probably 0xFF reads parsed as ±32767).
blockers.workaround: Phase 11 will rewrite src/shitbox/events/sampler.py for LSM6DSOX before Phase 10 smoke test resumes.

blockers.description: i2c bus hung once during testing with 'SDA stuck at low' at kernel uptime ~6599s. Daemon recovery path tries `sudo reboot` but systemd unit has NoNewPrivileges=true so sudo is denied — recovery path is effectively broken.
blockers.workaround: Bus recovered after manual intervention. Needs proper fix: either DT-level bus recovery overlay (scl-gpios/sda-gpios) or systemd watchdog fallback instead of sudo reboot. Tracked as Phase 11 gap.

blockers.description: Pi daemon is also logging 'unable to open database file' for every tile request — MBTiles file not present on the Pi at configured dashboard.tiles_path. Not a bug, just needs tools/download_tiles run against the rally corridor and the .mbtiles copied to the Pi.
blockers.workaround: Run tools/download_tiles on Pi or laptop with an appropriate bbox, copy the output to the path in config/config.yaml.

decisions.decision: Pause Phase 10 at Wave 4 and open Phase 11 for v2 hardware migration
decisions.rationale: Phase 10 dashboard rendering is verified working but live data is meaningless because the IMU sampler is still coded for the v1 MPU6050. Full v2 sensor migration (LSM6DSOX, LIS3MDL, DS18B20, new front cam, VEML7700, INA226, PM2.5) needed before Phase 10 smoke test can validate real telemetry.

next_action: Run /gsd:discuss-phase 11 with the locked scope (see context_notes) to gather detailed requirements for v2 hardware migration before planning.
context_notes: Phase 11 scope is already agreed. Must-haves: LSM6DSOX sampler rewrite (priority 1), new front cam udev + capture config (16MP 32e4:0298 replacing UGREEN 720p, priority 2), DS18B20 dual-probe 1-Wire collector for engine + outside with ROM ID labelling (priority 3), LIS3MDL magnetometer collector, delete collectors/temperature.py (MCP9808), config/pyproject cleanup incl. bme280→bme680 typo fix. Should-haves: VEML7700 ambient light collector, INA226 rewrite of power.py (keep enabled: false until shunt wired). Deferred-in-phase: DFRobot SEN0460 PM2.5 collector skeleton (enabled: false until hardware arrives). Explicitly unchanged: SSD1306 OLED, BME680, buzzer, USB speaker, cabin Brio 100, GPS, Phase 10 dashboard code. 4.7k pull-up for 1-Wire already present on Pi. Front cam fully replaced, not additive. DS18B20 probes label via ROM ID mapping in config (engine/outside). Phase 10 dashboard will consume real telemetry once Phase 11 collectors land. Broken daemon recovery path (sudo reboot under NoNewPrivileges) should be fixed within Phase 11 too — switch to systemd watchdog or DT bus recovery overlay.
